major_results: Exact historical NAcc source and exact E-PQ source were reconstructed from Project-Frankenstein commit abba90a5767d85abc8a1ac340bae92842dab35c1.
Historical NAcc source/test drift was confirmed and preserved as negative evidence rather than forcing stale tests to define truth.
Accepted-target VPS execution reproduced a direct historical genesis_self_accepted -> NAcc dopamine -> persistent E-PQ personality-state path with restart persistence.
Historical NAcc partial baseline completed 3000/3000 reward calls with zero failures on the accepted target, with latency distributions recorded rather than only means.
Typed/multiscale reward plasticity reference candidate passed 10/10 deterministic gates on the accepted target.

Exactly one GO out-of-box experiment, SELF_REWARD_LAUNDERING_CAROUSEL, passed fail-closed: self/activity/unverified signals could not mint material reward state; only bounded exploration nudge remained.

Producer-owned V17 terminal reward bridge discriminator passed 10/10 on the accepted target: default abstain, caller fractional credit forbidden, DONE/bound provenance required, explicit_no_learning respected, binary attribution explicitly marked uncalibrated.

Negative evidence proved the raw inner RewardPlasticityCandidate is not safe as a public authority boundary because a syntactically forged VERIFIED_OUTCOME with caller credit 1.0 yields material learning weight 1.0.

A new exactly-once reward-consumption blocker was identified before direct composition: terminal source receipts are re-readable and do not by themselves guarantee one-time persistent plasticity consumption.

architecture_fusion.persistent_value_plasticity: independently verified terminal outcome plus producer-owned causal attribution plus non-bypassable provenance and exactly-once consumption
architecture_fusion.intrinsic_guidance_hypothesis: retain bounded transient/value-free guidance or associative learning as a distinct candidate channel; do not let self-generated activation directly mint persistent value/personality
architecture_fusion.fractional_credit: UNRESOLVED; future producer-owned receipt must bind intervention/reference-policy/uncertainty/support/identity or abstain
architecture_fusion.binary_credit: valid only as an explicit experimental attribution policy, not a calibrated fraction
architecture_fusion.raw_plasticity: internal mechanism only, never public authority surface

strongest_counterhypotheses_remaining: A much simpler scalar verified-outcome plus binary attribution controller with explicit safety/homeostatic gates may dominate typed/multiscale reward on the declared Pareto vector.
Strictly blocking persistent internal reward until external verification may harm sparse-reward autonomy; a bounded guidance/association channel may be necessary.
A guidance-only channel could still become a behavioral proxy reward if policy selection optimizes it repeatedly.
A deterministic pure fold over a canonical unique terminal-receipt set may be safer/simpler than a mutable RewardConsumption ledger.
Fractional causal credit may add false precision and compute without enough incremental benefit over exact binary bound attribution for v0.1.
